COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No.64 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, Advocate for 
the revisionist.
 The challenge in this revision is made to 
the judgment and order dated 16.12.2024, 
passed in Criminal Case No.259 of 2023, 
Smt. Reshma and others vs. Shri Tosif, by 
the court of Additional Principal Judge, 
First Family Court, Dehradun. By it, the 
revisionist has been directed to pay
`17,500/- per month (Rs.7,500/- to 
respondent no.1 and Rs.5,000/- each to 
respondent nos.2 and 3) as maintenance. 
 Heard.
 Having considered, this Court is of the 
view that this matter requires deliberation.
 Admit.
 Issue notice to respondent nos.1 to 3, 
returnable within six weeks. Steps to be 
taken within a week.
 List on 05.05.2025. 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 13.02.2025
Sanjay

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No.64 of 2025
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, learned counsel for the 
Revisionist.
2. Mr. Gaurav Paliwal, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. 
Nalin Saun, learned counsel for the Respondents.
3. The present criminal revision is directed against the 
judgment and order dated 16.12.2024, passed by the court of 
learned Additional Principal Family Judge, First Family Court,
District Dehradun, in Criminal Case No.259 of 2023, “Smt. 
Reshma and others Vs. Shri Tosif”, whereby directing the 
Revisionist to pay an amount of Rs.17,500/- per month as 
interim maintenance to the Respondents i.e. wife, daughter and 
son. 
4. Admit.
5. Counter affidavit to be filed within a period of three 
weeks.
6. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the 
case, an interference is being called for in the matter.
7. Till the next date of listing, the effect and operation of 
the impugned judgment and order dated 16.12.2024, passed by 
the court of learned Additional Principal Family Judge, First 
Family Court, District Dehradun, in Criminal Case No.259 of 
2023, “Smt. Reshma and others Vs. Shri Tosif”, shall remain 
stayed, subject to the condition that the Revisionist shall deposit 
40% of the arrears due before the court concerned within a 
period of two weeks from today.
8. List this matter on 13.02.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 28.11.2025
Nitesh/
